lines.text: I was a brute beast before You.
Yet I am always with You;
You guide me with Your counsel,
and later receive me in glory.
Whom have I in heaven but You?
And on earth I desire no one besides You.
My flesh and my heart may fail,
but God is the strength of my heart
Those far from You will surely perish;
You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
But as for me, it is good to draw near to God.
I have made the Lord GOD my refuge,
that I may proclaim all Your works.

pictures.scene: Samuel Hirszenberg, Head of a Jew — the grave old face turned up into the light, so You O Lord awaken and despise their form, when my heart was grieved
pictures.name: pd_hirszenberg_head_of_a_jew

pictures.scene: Ludwig Knaus, Der Taschenspieler in der Scheune — the villagers packed into the barn staring at the conjuror's trick, and I was pierced within, I was senseless and ignorant
pictures.name: pd_knaus_taschenspieler_scheune

pictures.scene: Nicolaes Berchem, Herders met vee — the herdsman sitting among his cattle in the warm evening light, I was a brute beast before You, yet I am always with You
pictures.name: pd_berchem_herders_met_vee

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, The Blind Girl — the blind girl seated in the field holding the younger girl's hand under the double rainbow, You hold my right hand, You guide me with Your counsel
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_blind_girl

pictures.scene: Edward Burne-Jones, The Golden Stairs — the robed figures coming down the pale golden stair with their instruments, and later receive me in glory, whom have I in heaven but You
pictures.name: pd_burne_jones_golden_stairs

pictures.scene: Ferdinand Georg Waldmuller, Die unterbrochene Wallfahrt — the pilgrim woman fallen on the sunlit hill and held up by the others, and on earth I desire no one besides You, my flesh and my heart may fail
pictures.name: pd_waldmueller_unterbrochene_wallfahrt

pictures.scene: Abraham Govaerts, Wooded landscape with shepherds and their flock — the herdsman at rest with his beasts under the great trees, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever
pictures.name: pd_govaerts_wooded_landscape_shepherds

pictures.scene: Evelyn De Morgan, The Angel of Death — the dark-winged angel bending down over the seated woman with the scythe in his hand, those far from You will surely perish, You destroy all who are unfaithful to You
pictures.name: pd_de_morgan_angel_of_death

pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, Sunlight in the Blue Room — the sunlight lying along the wall of the quiet blue room where the child sits at her work by the window, but as for me it is good to draw near to God, I have made the Lord GOD my refuge
pictures.name: pd_ancher_sunlight_in_the_blue_room

pictures.scene: Hendrik Valkenburg, De brulfteneugers — the two wedding inviters walking the lane in their flowered hats to carry the invitation from door to door, that I may proclaim all Your works
pictures.name: pd_valkenburg_brulfteneugers
